{{Top|leg}}
'''Photoreducers''' were [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinocular]] components. They prevented a user from being blinded by a sudden increase in light. [[VidGraph/Legends|VidGraph's]] [[Peer Macrobinoculars]] were fitted with photoreducers.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
